owner: Government of Mongolia (New Kharkhorum city development, public-private partnership)
notes: New Kharkhorum city (Shine Kharkhorum) is being built in Kharkhorin sum, Ovorhangay aimag, ~360 km from Ulaanbaatar. Official Kharkhorin aimag/sum site reported a 2026-03-04 meeting discussing establishing a data center under public-private partnership within the city's master-plan/construction framework; government 2024-2028 action program also includes a data-center feasibility study for New Kharkhorum. Policy/planning stage: no site, developer, MW, or permit yet. Status planned.
